svg.title: Three parts of infrastructure automation
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Terraform: infrastructure and policies codified, shared, versioned and executed in one consistent workflow. Nomad: containers, binary files and VMs, in the cloud, on premises and across edge environments. NS1 Connect: endpoint health tracked in real time, with traffic shifted to healthy endpoints automatically.
